issues.description: Function set_pixel: Problem statement specifies the RGB color parameter is passed in register ECX. The template declares an empty set_pixel routine to be implemented by the student. The solution implementation of set_pixel (solution_repository/pixel.asm) writes the pixel value from EDX (instruction mov [eax], edx) instead of using ECX. This contradicts the problem statement and will cause the routine to write an incorrect value as the pixel color, confusing students and producing incorrect behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution's set_pixel implementation to store the RGB color from ECX into the computed pixel address instead of from EDX. For example, replace the incorrect store instruction (mov [eax], edx) with a 32-bit store using ECX (mov dword [eax], ecx or mov dword [computed_address_register], ecx). Ensure the routine still preserves registers as required by the exercise (do not clobber registers other than EAX) and that temporaries used for address calculation do not overwrite ECX before the final store. Also verify the address register used in the store contains the byte address of the pixel (add display_start and computed offsets appropriately) before performing the mov dword [addr], ecx.
